I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. The store is **Pine Crossing**.

On 9 June, Pree posted in #central-team that the Pine Crossing morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver had arrived at 7:10 and his trailer number was written on a sticky note. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem.

I couldn't find a separate site code or address for Pine Crossing in that channel or the two Central team files I read. I told her she'd need to get one from store ops if the sheet needs it.

I only read sources Pree can see herself: #central-team, which she's a member of, and those two public files.
